verdict.rationale: A payments platform with a merchant dashboard could plausibly offer AI-generated insights on transaction data, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only payment, transfer, checkout and developer integration features, with no AI-generated insights or suggestions. The 'smart payment ordering system' in checkout is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
